description: This header file defines functions related to fuel mapping and engine fuel calculations for an engine management system.

methods.name: initFuelMap
methods.description: Initializes the fuel map engine parameters.

methods.name: getBaseFuel
methods.description: Returns total injection time into all cylinders before temperature corrections.

methods.name: getRunningFuel
methods.description: Returns base fuel with CLT and IAT corrections.

methods.name: getRealMafFuel
methods.description: Calculates fuel based on air mass and engine RPM.

methods.name: getBaseTableFuel
methods.description: Gets fuel from the base table based on RPM and engine load.

methods.name: getBaroCorrection
methods.description: Calculates correction based on barometric pressure.

methods.name: getNumberOfInjections
methods.description: Determines the number of injections based on mode and engine parameters.

methods.name: getInjectionOffset
methods.description: Calculates injection timing offset based on RPM.

methods.name: getIatFuelCorrection
methods.description: Provides fuel correction based on Intake Air Temperature.

methods.name: getInjectorLag
methods.description: Calculates injector lag time based on battery voltage.

methods.name: getCltFuelCorrection
methods.description: Provides fuel correction based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getFuelCutOffCorrection
methods.description: Calculates fuel cut-off correction based on current time and RPM.

methods.name: getCltTimingCorrection
methods.description: Provides timing correction based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel
methods.description: Calculates fuel amount for engine startup.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel3
methods.description: Calculates crank fuel based on coolant temperature and revolution counter.

methods.name: getInjectionDuration
methods.description: Returns injection duration based on RPM.

methods.name: getInjectorDutyCycle
methods.description: Returns the duty cycle percentage for the injector based on RPM.

methods.name: getFuelRate
methods.description: Converts injection duration to fuel rate.
